abilities.descEn: Steal the opposing team's minerals, slowing their production.\n(Production is slowed by per Ranger with this Ability that joins the battle)
abilities.descZh: 奪取對方隊伍的礦物，降低礦物生產速度。\n(有此能力的Ranger參與戰鬥時，將降低對方的礦物生產速度)

abilities.descEn: Some of the Mineral used to produce that Ranger is restored when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時可回收一部份生產該Ranger時所消耗的礦物。

abilities.descEn: One of that Ranger's skills will activate when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時將發動一項自己的技能。

abilities.descEn: Fixed chance of ignoring a Light element enemy's Skill Resistance when attacking.
abilities.descZh: 攻擊時以一定機率無視光屬性敵人的技能抗性。
